aim: distinguish fixed correction and scripted action replay from learned state-dependent correction
scope: one fixed train grasp, anchor plus four policy-unseen calibration bias cases; exploratory, not final effect proof
order: case outer; mode order cyclically rotated by case index

source_trace.selection: active==true and policy_input_valid==true; post-phase done terminal action included

playback_tail: hold final absolute target action; no geometry feedback

predefined_interpretation.anchor_constant_success: anchor success is compatible with fixed correction
predefined_interpretation.anchor_playback_success: anchor success is compatible with an open-loop activation-step schedule
predefined_interpretation.transfer_ppo_success_not_greater_than_be: no aggregate PPO advantage observed in this diagnostic
predefined_interpretation.transfer_ppo_greater_than_nonlearning: potential state-response advantage, not effect proof; report every paired win and reverse loss
predefined_interpretation.runtime_invalid: preserve invalid evidence; stop, no outcome-based case/checkpoint replacement
